offers.title: 1.99% APR for 36 Months and $0 Down on 2024 FTR and MY25 Scout (1250 and Scout Sixty)
offers.combinable: May be combined with certain other offers (specifically customer cash).
offers.finePrint: 1.99% APR for 36 months with $0 down on new MY24 FTR and MY25 Scout models (1250 and Scout Sixty), excluding Scout Bobber Sixty. $28.64 per $1,000 financed; minimum financing amount varies.

offers.title: 1.99% APR for 36 Months and $0 Down on 2025 Indian Springfield, Chieftain, Roadmaster, PowerPlus Family, or Chief Models
offers.combinable: May not be combined with certain other offers (specifically trade-in credit or customer cash).
offers.finePrint: 1.99% APR for 36 months with $0 down on select new MY25 models; excludes Elite, 125th Anniversary, Signature Series, and Special Edition models. $28.64 per $1,000 financed; minimum financing amount varies by dealer.

offers.title: 4.99% APR for 36 Months and $0 Down on 2026 Chieftain, Chieftain PowerPlus, Indian Challenger, Indian Pursuit, Roadmaster, Roadmaster PowerPlus, Indian Springfield, or Scout Models
offers.combinable: May not be combined with certain other offers (specifically trade-in credit or customer cash).
offers.finePrint: 4.99% APR for 36 months with $0 down on new MY26 qualifying models; excludes Elite, 125th Anniversary, Signature Series, and Special Edition models. $29.97 per $1,000 financed; minimum financing amount varies.

offers.title: No Interest for 6 Months, No Payment for 7 Months on 2024 FTR and 2025 Models
offers.eligibility: Well-qualified applicants with approved credit through authorized U.S. Indian Motorcycle dealers
offers.combinable: May not be combined with certain other offers.
offers.finePrint: No interest accrues for 6 months and no payments for 7 months, then 8.99% APR for 60 months beginning June 1, 2027. Minimum amount financed $5,000; valid on new, unregistered 2024 FTR or 2025 models.

offers.title: Honoring Heroes Program: $1,000 in Accessories and Apparel and 1-Year IMR Elite Status
offers.eligibility: Active, reserve, National Guard and retired military personnel plus active and retired police and firefighter personnel, including volunteer firefighters and Border Patrol; verified through ID.me. Excludes Puerto Rico residents.
offers.finePrint: Up to $1,000 MSRP in Indian Motorcycle parts, garments and/or accessories plus 1-year Elite Status with purchase of a new, unregistered 2025 or 2026 Indian Motorcycle. One coupon per customer, non-transferable, not redeemable for cash or valid on IndianMotorcycle.com purchases.

offers.title: 2024 FTR $3,000 Customer Cash
offers.combinable: May be combined with promotional financing offers.
offers.finePrint: $3,000 Customer Cash rebate toward a new model year 2024 FTR. Paid to dealer and not redeemable for cash.

offers.title: $2,000 Customer Cash on 2025 Chieftain PowerPlus, Roadmaster PowerPlus, Indian Challenger, Indian Pursuit, Chieftain, Roadmaster or Indian Springfield
offers.combinable: May be combined with valid Trade-In Credit offers, but may not be combined with promotional financing offers.
offers.finePrint: $2,000 Customer Cash rebate on new 2025 qualifying models; excludes Elite, 125th Anniversary, Signature Series, and Special Edition models. Paid to dealer and not redeemable for cash.

offers.title: $1,500 Trade-In Credit on 2025 or 2026 Chieftain, Chieftain PowerPlus, Indian Challenger, Indian Pursuit, Roadmaster, Roadmaster PowerPlus, or Indian Springfield
offers.combinable: May be combined with valid customer cash offers, but may not be combined with promotional financing.
offers.finePrint: $1,500 Trade-In Credit toward a new 2025 or 2026 qualifying model; excludes Elite, 125th Anniversary, Signature Series, and Special Edition models. Limit one per vehicle purchase; paid to dealer and not redeemable for cash.

offers.title: 2025 Chief $1,500 Customer Cash
offers.combinable: May not be combined with promotional financing offers.
offers.finePrint: $1,500 Customer Cash rebate toward a new model year 2025 Chief. Paid to dealer and not redeemable for cash.

offers.title: 2025 Scout Classic, Scout Sixty Classic, Sport Scout and Sport Scout Sixty $1,000 Customer Cash
offers.combinable: May be combined with promotional financing offers.
offers.finePrint: $1,000 Customer Cash rebate on new 2025 Scout Classic, Scout Sixty Classic, Sport Scout and Sport Scout Sixty; excludes Scout Sixty Bobber. Paid to dealer and not redeemable for cash.

offers.title: 2025 Scout $500 Customer Cash
offers.combinable: May be combined with promotional financing offers.
offers.finePrint: $500 Customer Cash rebate toward a new model year 2025 Scout Bobber, Super Scout, 101 Scout, or Scout Sixty Bobber Limited. Paid to dealer and not redeemable for cash.

offers.title: Referral Program: $250 PG&A Credit
offers.eligibility: Referred customer who purchases a new, unregistered Indian Motorcycle within 60 days of receiving a referral email from an owner (U.S. and Canada); Polaris, dealers and employees not eligible.
offers.combinable: May be combined with other coupons, discounts, offers, or promotions, but not stacked with other referral codes.
offers.finePrint: Referred buyer and referring owner each receive a $250 parts, garments and accessories credit; referred buyer must present the unique code in-store and redeem in a single transaction. Owners limited to $500 in referral credits for 2026.
